title: Payments Operations Calendar Convention: Returned Payments and the First Three-Payment Settlement Due Day
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Returned-Payment Day Convention

When a consumer accepts a Three-Payment Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements on a recorded call, the returned consumer payments in the money history of the Placed Consumer Accounts record decide the day on which the first settlement payment falls.

**Convention.** The Three-Payment returned-payment day convention decides on which day the first payment falls: where two or more consumer payments on the account were returned with a return date after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date, the first payment is taken as guaranteed funds on the next business day after the acceptance date, Monday through Friday, and the shortened window is set aside; where exactly one consumer payment on the account was returned in that span, the shortened window is kept but a first payment that would fall due on a Saturday or a Sunday is moved back to the Friday before it, or forward to the Monday after it where that Friday would fall on or before the acceptance date; where none was returned in that span, the shortened window is used as it stands, whatever day of the week it ends on.

The shortened window is the call window as it stands after any shortening, in calendar days from the acceptance date; the convention gives the number of days from the acceptance date to the day the first payment falls.

## Returns in the span, and what follows

| Consumer payments returned in the twelve-month span | Day the first payment falls |
|---|---|
| two or more | the next business day (Monday to Friday) after the acceptance date |
| exactly one | the end of the shortened window, moved off a Saturday or Sunday as stated |
| none | the end of the shortened window, whatever weekday |

## Hypothetical cases

- Two returns in the span, acceptance on a Thursday: first payment the Friday, 1 day after acceptance. Acceptance on a Friday: the Monday, 3 days after. Acceptance on a Saturday: the Monday, 2 days after.
- One return, acceptance on a Monday, shortened window 12 days ending on a Saturday: moved back to the Friday, 11 days.
- One return, acceptance on a Friday, shortened window 1 day ending on the Saturday: the Friday before is the acceptance date itself, so the payment moves forward to the Monday, 3 days.
- One return, acceptance on a Saturday, shortened window 1 day ending on the Sunday: the Friday before falls before the acceptance date, so the payment moves forward to the Monday, 2 days.
- No return, shortened window ending on a Sunday: the Sunday stands.
